# expandable_plus

Expandable and collapsible panels with accordion groups for Flutter. A maintained, drop-in successor to the expandable package; adds header padding, fixes body-tap toggling.

pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/expandable_plus
source: https://github.com/Yusufihsangorgel/expandable_plus

## Before you call it

README.md carries the usage, the measured comparison against the alternatives, and a note on when not to reach for this package.

## Layout

- `lib/` — public API
- `example/` — runnable examples
- `test/` — the suite; `dart test` (or `flutter test`) runs it
